name: Single Backhandplate
description: Snap the plated lead fist straight out so the steel backplate lands first on nose or brow.

name: Glovebump
description: Swing the gauntleted hand outward from the shoulder and slap its steel back across the cheek.

name: Lowered Knucklecap
description: Raise the cuffed forearm upright before the face and take the blow on the steel.

name: Glovedash
description: Bend the elbow tight and sweep the plated fist in a short arc into the ribs.

name: Swaying Clench
description: Slide the rear foot back a pace while the armored fist stays raised to cover the retreat.

name: Leaden Wristcuff
description: Lift the gauntlet overhead and let its plated back fall onto the opponent's collarbone or guard.

name: Square Fingerplate
description: Tap two quick light blows of the steel backplate to brow and eyes to draw the guard up.

name: Snug Thumbplate
description: Turn the steel wrist cuff against an incoming fist and slide it off to the outside.

name: Sideways Cuffplate
description: Shuffle forward in small even steps with the gauntleted fist held steady at chin height.

name: Descending Vambrace
description: Open the glove and drive its steel palm into the chest to push the attacker back a pace.

name: Mittdash
description: Swing the steel fist down and across to strike the thigh and break the opponent's stance.

name: Mittstrike
description: Rotate the hips and swing the loaded rear fist across to land its steel on the jaw hinge.

name: Glovestrike
description: Stiffen the hand and jab the plated fingertips into the soft hollow beneath the ribs.

name: Towing Crushgrip
description: Close the steel fingers around the opponent's wrist and hold the hand against the body.

name: Vambcowl
description: Lift the steel back of the hand to the brow so glancing blows scrape off the plate.

name: Wringpace
description: Slip one pace sideways behind the raised plated forearm as the attacker lunges past.

name: Sharp Elbowcop
description: Close the glove into a hammer and pound it downward onto the shoulder joint.

name: Mittcowl
description: Fold the cuffed forearm across the body to knock a thrusting hand aside.

name: Gnawing Grasp
description: Flick the wrist outward so the steel backplate cracks across the opponent's nose.

name: Wide Wring
description: Drive the steel fist upward from the hip and under the opponent's chin.

name: Settled Wristcuff
description: Hold the plated back of the glove out at arm's length like a small steel screen.

name: Light Clamp
description: Turn a quarter circle on the ball of the foot so the swing misses the body.

name: Vamblid
description: Clap both gloved hands sharply beside the opponent's head to startle them and break their rhythm.

name: Wringdash
description: Swing the steel cuff edge of the forearm into the opponent's incoming arm to jar it.

name: Gauntcuff Hit
description: Drag the riveted edge of the backplate across the face as the hand withdraws.

name: Gnawing Vambrace
description: Root both feet and send the whole side of the body behind one straight steel fist.

name: Angled Palmguard
description: Cross both cuffed forearms into an X to stop a downward club swing.

name: Kept Thumbplate
description: Ride an incoming blade along the steel backplate and turn it off to the side.

name: Clamppause
description: Hook the cuffed arm over the opponent's arm and pin it against their ribs.

name: Stepping Backhandplate
description: Hop in on the lead foot behind a raised steel fist to close the distance.

name: Stiff Knucklecap
description: Bring both steel fists down together onto the raised guard to break it open.

name: Level Clamp
description: Carry a thread of qi to the fist and let it flare through the steel as the glove lands.

name: Lowered Palmguard
description: Exhale as the cuffed forearm meets a blow and firm the arm with a pulse of qi.

name: Cuffplate Strike
description: Set the steel palm against the body and push qi through it in one short thrust.

name: Easing Seizeup
description: Sink qi into the heels and step off a firm base without losing the fist's line.

name: Clampdrop
description: Trace a wide arc with the plated fist and release the qi at the end of the swing.

name: Elbowcop Wedge
description: Turn the qi-warmed backplate against a thrust and shed it to the outside.

name: Wringwedge
description: Snap the jointed steel fingers shut around a wrist and brace the hold with a pulse of qi.

name: Wide Grasp
description: Hook the plated fingertips behind a guard and yank it open to expose the chest.

name: Level Clench
description: Lock every finger joint rigid and drive the whole fist like a single block of steel.

name: Graspblow
description: Thrust the steel thumb into the muscle beside the collarbone to numb the arm.

name: Resting Gauntcuff
description: Spread the steel fingers wide before the face to catch a thrown dart or small stone.

name: Wring Hop
description: Pivot on the lead foot while holding a seized wrist and swing round behind the opponent.

name: Seizeup Husk
description: Slap the steel palm against the opponent's striking arm to knock the swing off its line.

name: Fouling Crushgrip
description: Close the mail-backed glove on a forearm and squeeze with qi until the arm weakens.

name: Planted Backhandplate
description: Turn the mail back into a slash so the links drag the edge aside.

name: Low Wring
description: Rake the mailed cuff down the opponent's wrist and hand with a short outward pull.

name: Sideways Gauntcuff
description: Slide a half-step sideways behind the mailed forearm as a cut passes.

name: Clamphit
description: Let the weight of the mailed glove fall in a loose hammer onto the shoulder.

name: Tight Fingerplate
description: Meet a sword edge flat with the steel vambrace and slip it away along the arm.

name: Angled Cuffplate
description: Raise the vambrace under a falling club and take its weight on the braced arm.

name: Wristcuff Wedge
description: Run the steel forearm along a spear shaft to clear the point from the body line.

name: Firm Crushgrip
description: Turn the parrying hand into a fist as the weapon clears and strike its wielder in the face.

name: Tight Elbowcop
description: Wedge both vambraces together into a steel cross against a thrust at the chest.

name: Knucklecap Pace
description: Step through the gap a parry opens and stand at the opponent's shoulder.

name: Clamp Stay
description: Spiral the cuffed wrist around a weapon's grip and bind the hand that holds it.

name: Snug Vambrace
description: Tuck the chin and fold the armored shoulder in behind the vambrace to take a heavy blow.

name: Clenchdash
description: Push a pulse of qi into the glove's weight so a straight blow lands like a dropped anvil.

name: Wringdrop
description: Shift the body weight onto the lead foot and swing the gauntlet into the ribs on the same breath.

name: Raised Fingerplate
description: Let qi settle into the cuffed forearm so a heavy blow stops against it without moving the arm.

name: Clenchstrike
description: Roll the loaded steel back of the hand outward in a full circle onto the temple.

name: Mittamble
description: Advance in short steps with qi held low so the heavy fist never drags the balance forward.

name: Holding Thumbplate
description: Snap the heavy fist back across the body after a swing and turn aside the counter.
